# NerdsTech

> NerdsTech is a full-stack digital studio offering AI automation, web design & development, branding, SEO, and mobile apps — one team, zero hand-offs.

AI · Design · Development — under one roof. Based in Murrysville, PA, working with clients everywhere.

## Services

- **AI Automation**: workflow automation, lead routing, CRM integrations, AI agents.
- **AI Chat Support**: 24/7 trained chat assistants with human hand-off.
- **AI Codebase Integration**: careful, module-by-module AI integration into your existing product — audit, roadmap, incremental rollouts, handover.
- **Web Design & Development**: custom high-performance websites (Next.js), no page builders.
- **Logo Design**: original logo concepts with full usage kits.
- **Brand Identity**: color, typography, voice, and brand guidelines.
- **Content Writing**: website copy, blogs, and product pages.
- **SEO & AI Search**: technical SEO, keyword strategy, llms.txt and AI-citation readiness.
- **Social Media Marketing**: channel strategy, creatives, paid social.
- **Motion Graphics**: explainers, product reveals, social clips.
- **Mobile App Development**: iOS & Android apps, store deployment, maintenance.

## Process

1. Discover — goals, customers, and bottlenecks mapped.
2. Design — wireframes to polished, on-brand interfaces.
3. Build — clean code, tested across devices.
4. Launch & Grow — ship, measure, iterate with SEO and automation compounding.

## Pricing (starting points)

- Launch: from $1,900 — brand starter kit or landing page.
- Grow: from $4,900 — custom multi-page website built to convert.
- Scale: from $9,900 — apps, automation, and growth engines.
